<thought>First, find a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (forward: aromatic amine + phenylsulfonyl chloride → sulfonamide). This matches the target’s sulfonamide group. Then, locate templates for the other required disconnections: (2) intramolecular Michael addition (flavanone cyclisation), (3) chalcone formation (Claisen‑Schmidt condensation), (4) electrophilic bromination of an aromatic ring, (5) nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) forming the aryl‑N bond, and (6) Boc‑deprotection (carbamate removal). Each search will return template IDs that can be used to build the 6‑step retrosynthetic tree.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
